description: OpenET provides satellite-based evapotranspiration information for water management. Its irrigation-demand role is explicit, contrary to the earlier exclusion of agricultural remote-sensing information. The metadata is published or maintained by OpenET consortium. The current FAQ specifies 23 western US states, with additional rasters for the Mississippi Alluvial Plain, at 30 m resolution. Monthly and annual products are available; daily coverage before 2024 is limited. The provider landing page describes access to CSV, API, raster material. Licence: not stated in the inspected metadata. The provider states that API access is free with quotas; an account is required. Caveats: Daily data before 2024 are being rebuilt, and temporal availability differs between tools. No data query or account flow was exercised. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support capacity planning. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. Related catalogue context is data-fao-aquastat-main-database. This is a thematic comparison, not a verified software dependency or claim of compatible inputs.
